newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged lower in early morning trade on Monday, depressed by the weakness of Nikkei futures in Chicago late last week, brokers said.
They said there was not much else to give the market direction, however.
After 10 minutes of trade, the Nikkei 225 was down 33.34 points or 0.18 percent at 18,165.40. Its March futures were down 90 points at 18,130 and June down 100 at 18,100.
"Futures in Chicago fell short of the Osaka close on Friday and there are few elements to spur buying," a trader at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
